title: MURDLE — The Retail Lab Distraction
subtitle: 4 suspects, 4 tools, 4 locations
storyHtml:
A distracting alert storm hit the Dynavics service desk while a critical LS Central retail configuration changed unexpectedly. The incident was traced to one consultant, one tool, and one workspace.

Each consultant had one tool in one location. Use the Business Central and LS Central evidence to close the case.

clues.text: Adam Sellers was preparing the API integration brief.
The Business Central laptop was not in the Support Hub.
Kieran Coles was working on the AL extension.
Kieran Coles was in the Business Central Sandbox.
The Business Central laptop was in the LS Central Retail Lab.
The incident was detected in the LS Central Retail Lab.
